summary: Optional markdown renderer built on react-markdown 10.1. Adopt only if formatted assistant output is needed: it adds about 87 packages and 72 KB gzip. Raw HTML is off by default, so the XSS surface is react-markdown's standard one.
reasoning: Wraps react-markdown 10.1 and does not enable rehype-raw or dangerous HTML in its published code.
Adds 87 packages to the tree and about 72 KB gzip on top of the core bundle.
Published through the same OIDC pipeline; 118 of 119 versions carry provenance.
The suite offers react-streamdown (Shiki, KaTeX, Mermaid) and react-syntax-highlighter for other rendering needs.
caveats: Any plugin that enables raw HTML (rehype-raw) reintroduces XSS risk; keep the default configuration.
Markdown parsing runs on every streamed token, so memoise or throttle if messages are long.
